expected_text_representation.diacritics: Preserved. The C++ main.cc splits words strictly by white space on the reference Uthmani text.

pronunciation_dictionary_dependency.mechanism: Every space-separated word from the Tanzil text must have an exact matching phonetic transcript in the CMU Sphinx lexicon (.dict file).
pronunciation_dictionary_dependency.risk: HIGH. If a word is missing from the precompiled dictionary, PocketSphinx fails to construct the grammar trellis and crashes. Unlike general-purpose ASR, it cannot handle out-of-vocabulary (OOV) words or custom textual variations dynamically.

reversibility_and_indexing.indexing_method: Uses 0-based word indices representing the position of the word in the space-separated Tanzil text of that ayah. This preserves a clean 1:1 mapping back to the canonical Uthmani scripture.
